description: This header file defines functions and macros for quoting and dequoting strings, particularly in the context of shell command construction. It includes utilities for safe quoting, dequoting, and escaping strings in various programming languages, as well as path quoting with respect to a prefix.

methods.name: sq_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string for shell safety, replacing single quotes and exclamation points, and enclosing in single quotes.

methods.name: sq_quote_argv
methods.description: Quotes an array of strings for shell safety.

methods.name: sq_quotef
methods.description: Formats and quotes a printf-style formatted string into a buffer.

methods.name: sq_quote_buf_pretty
methods.description: Provides a human-readable version of quoting without exotic character escaping.

methods.name: sq_quote_argv_pretty
methods.description: Provides a human-readable quoting for argument vectors.

methods.name: sq_append_quote_argv_pretty
methods.description: Appends a human-readable quoted argument vector to a buffer.

methods.name: sq_dequote
methods.description: Dequotes a string produced by sq_quote(), returning the unquoted string.

methods.name: sq_dequote_step
methods.description: Dequotes one item from a string, advancing the pointer.

methods.name: sq_dequote_to_argv
methods.description: Dequotes a string into an argv array, modifying in place.

methods.name: sq_dequote_to_strvec
methods.description: Dequotes a string into a strvec, duplicating and owning the strings.

methods.name: unquote_c_style
methods.description: Dequotes a C-style quoted string.

methods.name: quote_c_style
methods.description: Quotes a string in C style, with optional flags.

methods.name: quote_two_c_style
methods.description: Quotes two strings in C style, with flags.

methods.name: write_name_quoted
methods.description: Writes a name quoted to a file, with a terminator.

methods.name: write_name_quoted_relative
methods.description: Writes a name quoted relative to a prefix to a file, with a terminator.

methods.name: quote_path
methods.description: Quotes a path as relative to a given prefix, with flags.

methods.name: perl_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a buffer for Perl string literals.

methods.name: perl_quote_buf_with_len
methods.description: Quotes a buffer for Perl with specified length.

methods.name: python_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a buffer for Python string literals.

methods.name: tcl_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a buffer for Tcl string literals.

methods.name: basic_regex_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a buffer for use in regex patterns.
